entries.cf959d1d46369ad2: The Golf Business is the center of the group's revenue, and the risk information prints that its share of revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was 79.1%. While the number of golf course users, which rose during the pandemic period, has turned to a gradual decline due to weather effects such as intense heat, demand is solid, as the market price of golf memberships in the Kanto area rose for 5 consecutive years in 2025, and the company views the revived golf boom as continuing. In the Travel Business, inbound demand is progressing steadily, with the number of visitors to Japan exceeding 40 million in 2025.
entries.d74c0e55a69c7aac: A business in which Sankei Ryokou Co., Ltd. and Esprit Golf Co., Ltd., consolidated subsidiaries, conduct travel business under the Travel Agency Act. They offer group planned tours combining golf and travel, such as bus tours for foreign residents in Japan, custom-ordered planned tours, and arranged travel including airline tickets and accommodation. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥662 million.
entries.e5806aab0fd58f7b: A business that plans and sells products combining golf and travel, such as the "1-Person Booking Golf Trip," which can be joined from 1 person, and the "Overseas VG Cup," in which participants play at golf courses overseas. It also plans and sells country-specific bus tours of sightseeing spots across Japan for foreign residents of Japan. The amount is not disclosed independently.
entries.e7d09752fa906263: Its corporate philosophy is 'to give form to what people want to do in the world'. As its medium- to long-term management strategy, it cites strengthening business collaboration among group companies to create new services, using group assets effectively to improve management efficiency, reviewing businesses and services with weak profitability as appropriate, and building new business pillars following the Golf Business and Travel Business. Following its entry into the real estate business, advertising and promotion, and up-front investment in the ＡＩ field during the current consolidated fiscal year, the company positions itself as now being in a 'monetization phase' aimed at accelerating investment recovery and profit growth, and plans to launch new services incorporating technological results accumulated at its ＡＩ Utilization Research Institute and to establish revenue models in new areas such as real estate.
entries.e9342f86d23845b5: "1-Person Reservation Land" is a service that makes it possible to reserve, even as 1 person, golf courses that can normally be used only as a group; registered members make reservations from the portal site "Value Golf WEB" and others, and can play once a group with other members is formed. "Ripizo-kun" is a service that provides golf courses' own websites with a WEB reservation system and a website management system, and it also offers "Ripizo-kun DX", which streamlines operations. It earns a monthly usage fee (a fixed fee plus a usage-based charge according to results in attracting customers) from contracted golf courses. The amount is not disclosed separately.
